title: Platina — Live in Yerevan: the patch (proposed), 50 units on 3 universes
owner: 2026-11-10 20:55 (ledger N3531): addresses for the Platina lights, now. The Platina side has no patch (forwarded chat, 2026-11-09: 'est patch?' — no, we can make it).
status: PROPOSED. Nothing here is confirmed by the Platina side or the rental house: the maker of 'Pixel Line IP', the mode set on each unit, who runs the desk, the node and its ports. The counts and names are the light plot's legend (PERED.pdf / _.pdf, read 2026-11-10).
crewLine: PROPOSED, not yet confirmed by the Platina side: check the mode on each unit before setting an address.
howToRead: docs/architecture/RIG_BUILD.md §19.5. No project document yet: the crew table comes from this plan alone — node scripts/rigbuild/patch-table.mjs --plan <this> --out <dir> --pdf. Never edit an address by hand: change the plan and print again.
method: One universe per KIND, the owner's way (MOXIR, 2026-10-15): U1 the 11 B-EYE K10 washes; U2 the 7 Sharpy beams and the 8 HY B-EYE K15; U3 the 24 Pixel Line IP bars.

Every unit is patched in its maker's SMALLEST full mode, and the units stand one LARGER mode apart (pitch): K10 35 (Shapes), Sharpy 20 (Vector), K15 36 (Shape), Pixel Line 21. A unit switched to the larger mode on the night keeps its address.
Blocks start on round numbers; the fixture number's hundred is the universe.

node.what: ASSUMED: one Art-Net / sACN node with 3 DMX outputs (or the house desk's own outputs); not on the plot
node.numbering: U1 = Art-Net 0.0.0 = sACN 1; U2 = 0.0.1 = sACN 2; U3 = 0.0.2 = sACN 3

crewNotes: PROPOSED patch, 2026-11-10: to be confirmed by the Platina side before a unit is set. Open: who runs the desk; the mode really set on each unit; the maker of the Pixel Line IP and its mode; the node and which output feeds which truss.
Counting: 'the audience's left' is the left as seen from the hall, looking at the stage.
U3 holds 24 devices on one DMX line only if the bars' data is daisy-chained tower to tower; split it where the cable run asks, the addresses stay.
